Class UserService

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.service.UserService
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserManagementService
@Service public class UserService extends Object implements UserManagementService
Service layer responsible for managing User entities.

This class provides core business logic for:

  • User registration
  • User creation and deletion
  • User retrieval and updates

Data Source Behavior:

  • Uses UserRepository when running in Spring context
  • Falls back to in-memory storage for unit testing

Security Features:

  • Passwords are hashed using PasswordEncoder
  • User roles are normalized to uppercase

      public User register(RegisterRequest registerRequest)
      Registers a new user in the system.

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the saved User entity
